theorems.name: Submission.gwe_wewe_energy_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (K0 σ E : ℝ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (W : Rn n → ℝ), 0 ≤ K0 → 0 < σ → 0 ≤ E → LipschitzOnWith 1 f (closedBall 0 (σ / 2)) → Measurable W → (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), x ∈ ball 0 (3 * σ / 8) → W x = 0 ∨ 1 ≤ W x) → volume (ball (0 : Rn n) (3 * σ / 8) ∩ {x | W x = 0}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K0 * E * σ ^ n) → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (3 * σ / 8), ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x) * W x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K0 * E * σ ^ n) → IntegrableOn (fun x => hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x)) (ball (0 : Rn n) (3 * σ / 8)) ∧ ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (3 * σ / 8), hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x) ≤ (1 + n) * K0 * E * σ ^ n
